ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure marks the "Ural River". The isobar distribution near it shows that the pressure on the east side and northeast side is relatively high, and relatively high pressure values such as 1025 and 1030 can be seen; the pressure on the southwest side is relatively low, about around 1020. Then reason: This place is located in the Northern Hemisphere. Airflow in a high-pressure area in the Northern Hemisphere diverges clockwise and flows from high pressure toward low pressure, so the Ural River basin is mainly affected at this time by continental cold air coming from the north and northeast. High-latitude inland cold air has low temperature and little water vapor, so the weather condition is cold and dry.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：观察等压线图，定位“乌拉尔河”，读取其附近东侧/东北侧气压高、西南侧较低的配置。再推理：按北半球高压顺时针环流和由高压向低压的风向规律，判断乌拉尔河流域此时主要受偏北、东北方向的大陆性冷空气控制。最后结合高纬内陆气流性质，得出天气为寒冷干燥。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中标出了“乌拉尔河”，其附近等压线分布表现为东侧、东北侧气压较高，可见1025、1030等较高气压值；西南侧气压相对较低，约为1020附近。再推理：该地位于北半球，高压区气流顺时针辐散，并由高压向低压方向流动，因此乌拉尔河流域此时主要受偏北、东北方向来的大陆性冷空气影响。高纬内陆冷空气温度低、含水汽少，所以天气状况为寒冷干燥。
